provenance: GNSA operational guidance approved by the GNSA STA team (corrected IEPF answers); not independently verified on the website and not a regulatory circular.
facts: The supplied GNSA guidance describes filing IEPF-5 via GNSA for a holder possessing the original share certificate. If the certificate is unavailable, or the claim involves transmission, contact GNSA INFOTECH PRIVATE LIMITED for the applicable IEPF Entitlement Letter and loss-of-certificate/transmission procedure.
The IEPF Entitlement Letter in this company claim process is not the dematerialisation Letter of Confirmation. Do not apply changes to that different document to this claim.

GNSA provides assistance with the applicable claim documents and verification process. The supplied guidance directs shareholders to its IEPF Help Kit/procedures page; claim documents vary for certificate loss and transmission.
Before transfer to IEPF, eligible shareholders may contact GNSA to claim unpaid dividend. Statutory transfers are performed by the company, not the shareholder.
